properties.note: Centroid of a national grid cell (~100 km2) whose measured building density falls in the 50-125 bldg/km2 gap identified in docs/issues/roofclf-calibration-density-mismatch.md: the sparsest quadrat currently in the roofclf coverage-ratio/area-recall fit is 124 bldg/km2 (Bahawalnagar Rural), but 13.5% of in-domain buildings nationally sit in cells sparser than that (median ~89 bldg/km2). This point is a coarse regional screen, NOT a verified settlement -- zoom in in JOSM, check Esri World Imagery Wayback or Google Earth Pro's historical slider for imagery recency BEFORE mapping (per Box 17/18's lesson: check imagery date before drawing, not after), and nudge this box onto an actual visible settlement. Purpose: extend the coverage-ratio/area-recall fit's own density support down toward the domain floor (48.5 bldg/km2), not to widen the domain itself.
